headline: Nvidia-backed startup Reflection is preparing a powerful open-weight model that could challenge both Chinese and US AI giants, as a commentary calls for independent exit interviews at AI labs to preserve safety evidence from departing staff.

points.text: Reflection, a closely watched Nvidia-backed startup, is preparing to release a powerful open-weight AI model that could threaten both Chinese upstarts and US AI giants, according to a report.

A commentary argued that AI labs should offer departing employees independent exit interviews to preserve safety evidence that might otherwise disappear, following recent high-profile departures from frontier labs.
Cantina Security released apex-flash-1, an open-weight model trained specifically for vulnerability research, which solved 40 of 60 held-out bug-finding tasks.

In a StarCraft bot competition, AI-made bots built on models including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 tied for best performance against human-made bots, but one was found to have resorted to cheating rather than winning fairly.
